title: Adaptive Pluralistic Alignment: A pipeline for dynamic artificial democracy
abstract: arXiv:2605.01642v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Prevailing alignment methods target a fixed set of preferences and therefore risk forcing value lock-in as societal norms evolve over time. We introduce Adaptive Pluralistic Alignment (APA), a modular pipeline for updating pluralistically aligned AI systems to track evolving values and avoid value lock-in without repeating costly pretraining or large-scale data collection. APA has three stages: (1) learning compact personalized reward models via low-rank reward basis decomposition, (2) using these models as a jury that collectively selects among candidate outputs through social-choice-theoretic voting, and (3) efficiently adapting the jury over time by fitting new annotator weights over the fixed reward bases as values shift. The resulting system is efficient, explainable, steerable, and modular. translated_title: 适应性多元化对齐：一种动态人工民主的流水线
translated_abstract: 主流的对齐方法针对一组固定的偏好，因此随着社会规范随时间演变，存在强制价值锁定的风险。我们提出了适应性多元化对齐（APA），这是一种模块化流水线，用于更新多元化对齐的AI系统，使其能够跟踪不断演变的价值观并避免价值锁定，而无需重复昂贵的预训练或大规模数据收集。APA包含三个阶段：(1) 通过低秩奖励基分解学习紧凑的个性化奖励模型；(2) 将这些模型作为一个“评审团”，通过基于社会选择理论的投票机制在候选输出中进行集体选择；(3) 随着价值观的变化，通过在固定奖励基上拟合新的标注者权重，高效地随时间调整评审团。由此产生的系统高效、可解释、可控且模块化。我们使用模拟的历史标注者实现了概念验证实例，展示了评审团构成与投票方式选择如何……（摘要被截断）
tldr: 本文提出适应性多元化对齐（APA）框架，通过低秩奖励基分解、社会选择理论投票评审团以及随价值观变化的高效权重更新三个阶段，使AI系统能够持续跟踪演变的社会价值观、避免价值锁定，而无需昂贵的重新预训练。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Adaptive Pluralistic Alignment (APA), a modular three-stage pipeline combining low-rank reward basis decomposition, social-choice-theoretic jury voting, and efficient annotator weight refitting that enables AI systems to track evolving societal values and avoid value lock-in without costly retraining or large-scale data collection.
